items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I used to go down there and jam. That's when I met Dizzy and...

ctx.x: Monroe's Uptown House, which was down in the basement. That's... In fact, that's where Campanella's Whiskey Store is now. I used to... I lived right up on the second floor or something, and I lived right in that area where you could hear the music coming straight up. I used to go down there and jam. That's when I met Dizzy and... I guess I had met Dizzy before. But I became very acquainted with his thing and Charlie's thing, because I lived right upstairs and I could hear the whole thing. You know, I used to go…
Did what they were doing then sound like they were trying to be different, or...?
